children: Mahesh Muralidhar Pai takes charge as Managing Director and CEO of South Indian Bank, bringing nearly three decades of experience across banking, strategy and digital transformation

South Indian Bank has appointed Mahesh Muralidhar Pai as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, effective October 1, 2026. Pai succeeds the bank's previous leadership as it continues to focus on business growth, technology-led transformation and strengthening its customer franchise.

Pai brings close to three decades of experience across several areas of universal banking, including business strategy, governance, digital banking, treasury, foreign exchange, retail banking, agriculture and micro, small and medium enterprise (MSME) credit.

He joins South Indian Bank after a long career with Canara Bank, where he most recently served as Chief General Manager. During his tenure, Pai handled a range of strategic and business-critical responsibilities, including establishing the bank's gold loan vertical.

He also led one of Canara Bank's largest zones, gaining experience across business development, customer acquisition, credit management and banking operations in diverse markets. His career included an international assignment with Canara Bank's operations in New York, giving him exposure to overseas banking, international operations and global financial markets.

Beyond his banking responsibilities, Pai has served on the boards of several financial and industry institutions, including the Fixed Income Money Market and Derivatives Association of India (FIMMDA), SWIFT India Domestic Services Pvt. Ltd. and Karnataka State Financial Corporation.

At South Indian Bank, Pai will take charge with a mandate centred on business growth, disciplined execution, digital transformation and strengthening customer relationships. His remit will also involve building on the bank's existing capabilities while identifying opportunities across its businesses.

Commenting on the appointment, Jose Joseph Kattoor, Chairman, South Indian Bank, said Pai brings together banking expertise, business leadership and experience in executing strategic initiatives. He added that Pai's leadership would be important as the bank works to deepen customer relationships and accelerate its digital and business transformation.

Pai said his immediate focus would be on driving the bank's businesses, pursuing growth opportunities with discipline and strengthening its capabilities for an evolving financial landscape. He also highlighted sharper execution, technology-led transformation and deeper customer engagement as key priorities.

The appointment comes as South Indian Bank continues to strengthen its position in a rapidly changing banking environment, where digital capabilities, credit quality, customer acquisition and operational execution are increasingly central to long-term growth.
